flowchart LR

    GW --> CFG[("路由規則/小編群設定")]
    GW --> CC["建立諮詢 Conversaion"]
    CC --> |Graph API| MS["Microsoft 365"]
    GW --> RT["Routing Engine"]
    RT --> DS["Directory查詢/發送訊息"]
    DS --> Q[("隊列/Kafka or Service Bus")]
    Q --> AB["Azure Bot"]
    AB --> |Bot Framework| MS["Microsoft 365"]
    AB -.-> OBS["Metrics/Logs/Traces"]
    GW -.-> n1["Metrics/Logs/Traces"]
    n1@{ shape: rect}
